caption: GSEA running enrichment scores of 3 gene sets in one ranked list of 4,000 genes. Top, running enrichment score (weighted Kolmogorov–Smirnov statistic, weight 1), one line per set. Middle, positions of the set members, one row per set in legend order. Bottom, ranking metric; dashed line, where it crosses zero. Sets: inflammatory response (80 genes in the list, NES = 2.61, adjusted P = 3.2 × 10^−6); cellular response to interleukin-1 (100 genes in the list, NES = 1.93, adjusted P = 0.0042); oxidative phosphorylation (75 genes in the list, NES = −2.20, adjusted P = 1.1 × 10^−4).
